policy.identity: Exact 2024–25 CCD NCES LEA 4816230 / ST_LEAID TX-057905; CCD ST_SCHID TX-057905-057905sss crosswalks to the complete nine-digit TAPR CAMPUS 057905sss with DISTRICT 057905. Names never join.
policy.population: Use complete native 2025 fall enrolled counts EE, PK, K, 1–12 reconciled to CPNTALLC. No positive grades9–12, plus positive grades3–8, defines the prospective grade-school population. Retain primary-only, high-only, mixed, unknown, zero and absent records separately. Do not select by CCD level, reference GRDTYPE/GRDSPAN, school type, charter status or residuals.
policy.income: Individual October25,2024 PEIMS fall economic status, CP NTECO / NTALL, including free/reduced meal eligibility or other public assistance, codes01/02/99. Same-year all-enrolled EE–12 denominator; ED+nonED and native tenth-percent display must reconcile. This broader state-specific proxy is not uniform FRPL or household income; it does not exactly describe tested pupils.
policy.income_limits: CEP requires individual direct certification and annual local income surveys; universal meals do not classify all children. Provision2 can retain base-year eligibility for continuously enrolled students. Missing surveys may be00; undercount unknown. Jan16,2025 resubmission extension requires enrolled/eligible October25,2024; not another-year backfill.
policy.assessment: Exact native 2024–25 All Students TAPR enrolled-grades3–8 Math/Reading Including EOC, At Meets Grade Level or Above: the original whole-percent R cells establish prospective outcomes. Native #Tests and #Meets-or-above remain unverified raw evidence. Accountability subset requires same district/campus on fall snapshot and testing date. STAAR with/without accommodations, Spanish STAAR, Alternate2 and corresponding AlgebraI/EnglishI–II EOC are included as documented. Separate TPRS all-testers, both-subject passing and participation measures are not used.
policy.eligibility: Reconstruct exact operational same-year CCD attachments, complete native enrolled EE/PK/K/1–12 counts with positive grades 3–8 and zero grades 9–12, reconciled individual economic status and each original unmasked whole-percent R cell. Preserve all 189 grade-school profiles; blank Alternative campus 057905241 stays in source but outside all three 188-school fits. Reported tests/numerators, charter/type/reference labels and diagnostics never select membership.
policy.outcome: Only original published whole-percent CDA38AM0E225R / CDA38AR0E225R. Do not reconstruct masks, substitute count-ratio precision, reuse statewide or Houston fits, or average grade percentages.
policy.combined: Equal mean of eligible original published Math and ELA whole-percent subject rates; not a count-derived ratio or the native fraction passing both. Never average grades or weight by enrollment.
policy.counts: Native reported #Tests and #Meets-or-above remain complete unverified raw evidence. Where all are available, their arithmetic can be reconciled with the original whole-percent display, but it does not certify valid-score denominators or select point-rate membership. Exact 2025 N/NAAR and M/medical performance-status mapping remains unresolved under the existing hold; no failed investigation is repeated. All valid-score counts, sampling variances and intervals remain null/unavailable, and the ten-valid-scored floor stays uncertified.
policy.models: Separate unweighted 2024–25 Dallas grade-school Math, ELA and Combined district OLS; no enrollment weights, fit-driven exclusions or national pooling.
policy.studentization: Externally studentized residuals use every explicit deleted-school fit and N−3 residual degrees of freedom, with independent centered full fits and held-out leverage. Cook distance and line sensitivity are descriptive, never exclusions.
policy.intervals: Every valid-score count, sampling variance and interval endpoint is null modelwide; the ten-valid-scored floor is uncertified. An internal zero variance vector is solely a computational sentinel, never an uncertainty estimate.
policy.compact_provenance: The complete committed immutable source is the authoritative raw-record store. Exact whole-blob, source-code/tests/policy, raw-input/schema/definition fingerprints are required on every replay. Compact model inputs retain exact x/y/identities and original table row/field references; no loss of raw auditability is authorized.
policy.release: Numerical audit only, pending independent review and separate canonical/browser integration. All historical and numerical source/modeling approvals remain false; no high/mixed/primary/nonoperational population or count hold is released.

retained_source_reference.note: Every original record/header/definition/raw value remains in the immutable linked source artifact and must validate on every numerical replay; compact references never permit unavailable or changed source evidence.
